title: Jailbreaking is (Mostly) Simpler Than You Think
reasoning: The paper focuses on a security vulnerability (Context Compliance Attack) to bypass AI safety filters. While it mentions alignment to ethical behaviors, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves; rather, it uses 'harmful' prompts (e.g., self-harm, hate speech) solely to test the efficacy of the jailbreak method.
